arguments.text: Calib: CP 203 W, HRmax 180, lag 50 s, creep 2/10min. COMPRESSED HR: 150 at 50%, 160 at 65%, 168 at 80%, 174 at 100%; HR separates efforts only up to 0.61 CP, so hard efforts must be read by pace. Blade eff very steep with rate (0.42 at 50 spm, 0.60 at 56, 0.74 at 65). S1 (17C, says Good): warm-up ~93 W at 52 spm, HR ~157 = +8 bpm over model (HR share 0.58 vs pace 0.46) before first turn, cause unknown (current against on way out? or HR offset).

arguments.why: check route gap once the computer knows the current

text: Keeping the guide (combined, agree, HR trusted up to 0.61 of CP). Will check the route gap after the first turn when the current is known.

arguments.text: S1 min 11: paddler: water against on way out, tide turns DURING session (expect current estimate to lag after the change). Interval 1 (8-12, 69 spm): pace ~214-239 W = 1.06-1.17 CP, HR 175-177 (2-4 below model), HR route ~0.95-1.0 but cannot tell above 0.61. Computer current est 0.08 after first turn (10.2). Leg-speed comparison also suggests ~0.08 m/s. Warm-up HR +5..8 bpm over model at easy effort; paddler feels Good.

arguments.why: look at interval 2 with current known on both legs

text: Guide unchanged; hard efforts read by pace with the computer current estimate. Rechecking at min 17.

arguments.text: S1 min 17: interval 2 back leg, current est 0.08 steady: pace 220-224 W = 1.09-1.10 CP at 69 spm (above threshold), HR 174-178, 2-5 below model. Recovery 50 spm ~90 W. Intervals look planned near 1.1 CP. Guide unchanged so far (combined/agree, HR to 0.61, cp_scale 1).

text: Readings consistent; guide unchanged.

arguments.text: S1 summary: 5x4min at 69 spm; pace read 1.12,1.10,1.12 then 1.00,0.99 (ints 4-5, after tide turn?); HR 177-179 all five (HR shares 1.01->0.92). Cool-down 50 spm pace 0.51 vs HR 0.45 (HR -5 vs model) while warm-up was HR +8 (no current est, water against out). Suggests current ~0.15 against out early, falling; pace may have under-read late ints if est lagged the tide turn OR blade fatigue. Unresolved. S2: 21C, Fine, one long steady piece 6-46 then cool-down.

arguments.why: first look at the long piece with the current known; ask conditions

text: Guide unchanged for now; checking after the first turn.

arguments.text: S2 min 11: paddler: water against on way out, BUILDING through session (computer est will lag -> out leg pace under-reads, back leg over-reads). Long piece at 65 spm: out leg pace 0.68-0.69 (no est), back 0.74-0.79; HR 167, HR share ~0.74 (gap ~0). Truth looks ~0.72, right at endurance/tempo edge. Calibration points at 65 spm average eff 0.757 vs fitted 0.736, so pace over-reads ~3% at 65 spm: set cp_scale 1.03 (reset for other rates).

arguments.why: see back-leg pace with the current estimate vs HR

text: cp_scale 1.03 to correct the blade-efficiency curve at 65 spm; rechecking at min 16.

arguments.text: S2 min 16: back leg (est 0.11) pace raw 0.75-0.78 flipping to tempo; HR 167 steady, HR share 0.72-0.74, HR 1.5-2 below model at pace power. Building current => back leg pace over-reads; truth likely ~0.72 endurance. Set cp_scale 1.06 to keep pace below 0.75 (under-reading within endurance is harmless). RESET cp_scale at next session start (it is session-specific).

arguments.why: mid-session check of pace vs HR drift (building current, heat creep, blade fatigue)

text: cp_scale 1.06 keeps the long piece reading endurance on the over-reading back leg; checking again at min 31.

arguments.text: S2 min 31: steady endurance read on both legs with cp_scale 1.06: out leg pace 0.68-0.72, back 0.71-0.74; HR 168-171, HR share 0.72-0.74, HR gap vs model about -1 (HR agrees with pace once current est caught up: est 0.14-0.15, signed per leg, negative = against). Paddler Good. No heat excess seen at 21C.

text: Both routes agree on endurance; guide kept.

arguments.text: S3 (20C, 50-min piece 6-56): paddler says water WITH us on way out. Warm-up pace raw 0.59 vs HR 0.53 (HR -5 vs model) => current about +0.1 with boat out. Set current_before_first_turn_mps +0.1, reset cp_scale to 1.0. If piece is at 65 spm again consider cp_scale ~1.03 (eff curve bias).

arguments.why: check the long piece once the current is known

text: Pre-turn current set to +0.1 m/s with the boat on the way out; cp_scale reset to 1.0.

arguments.text: S3 min 10: piece at 63 spm. Out leg (pre-turn, my +0.1 current) pace 0.68-0.69; turn 9.4, computer est 0.14 (with boat out). HR 162, HR share 0.64-0.66, HR 2-5 below model at uncorrected pace power. Both routes endurance with margin; guide kept (cp 1.0).

arguments.why: check drift in the second half of the long piece

text: Both routes read endurance; guide kept.

arguments.text: S3 min 18-19: strap locked onto stroke rate (reads 63 = spm). Plausibility check drops it; pace carries the reading (endurance 0.67). Asked fix_strap. Note computer current est fell to -0.09 back / +0.01 out after 2nd turn: current fading.

text: Strap fix requested; pace carries the reading meanwhile.
Strap reads plausibly again (HR 166-167), both routes agree on endurance; guide kept.

arguments.text: S3 min 30: strap fixed by 21 (wet + re-seat worked in ~2 min). Piece steady: pace 0.66-0.70, HR 166-167, HR share 0.65-0.69, HR 2 below model at pace power. Endurance throughout. Current fading (est 0.14 -> 0.08). Odd: HR route sometimes gives a zone at share 0.64-0.65 despite trust limit 0.61.

text: Guide kept; checking the cool-down.

arguments.text: S3 end: piece stayed endurance 0.65-0.70 to min 55 (HR crept to 172, matching model + creep); cool-down 50 spm recovery on both routes (pace 0.42, HR 0.44-0.46). Current faded to ~0 by min 50 (tide). Guide at end: combined/agree, HR to 0.61, cp 1.0, pre-turn current +0.1 (reset/re-judge next session).

text: Cool-down reads recovery on both routes; guide kept.

arguments.text: S4 (23C, warmest): stretches 8-23, 23-33, 33-38, 38-48, cool 48-53. Water AGAINST on way out, building. Warm-up raw pace 0.52 vs HR 0.63 (+6 bpm): current ~0.1-0.16 against plus maybe heat. Set pre-turn current -0.12. History: when current est known, HR matched model within 1 bpm at endurance in S2 and S3, so HR model is sound at moderate effort.

arguments.why: check first stretch with the current known; ask feel (heat)

text: Pre-turn current set against the boat; checking after the turn.

arguments.text: S4 min 11: stretch 1 at 65 spm. HR 163 (like S3 endurance ~0.66) while back-leg pace with lagging est (0.09, true ~0.15 from leg speeds) reads 0.75. Paddler Good. In S2/S3 raw pace and HR agreed within 2% at endurance, so HR is a sound second opinion there: set hr_trust_up_to_share 0.75 so agree averages both in endurance (damps the leg-alternating current error). Above 0.75 pace alone.

arguments.why: see what the 23-33 stretch is and how the routes compare

text: HR now trusted to 0.75 so endurance is read as the average of both routes.

arguments.text: S4 min 25: stretch 1 (8-23) endurance: HR 163-165, pace 0.65-0.69 (avg used). Stretch 2 (23-33) at 67 spm: pace 0.93-0.97 threshold, HR 176 rising. Computer current est on out leg FELL 0.17->0.12 when the paddler sped up at 23 (estimate seems confounded by the effort change; paddler said current building) -> back leg after turn ~26.7 may over-read toward 1.05.

arguments.why: check back-leg threshold reading for over-read from a low current estimate

text: Threshold stretch read by pace; checking after the turn.

arguments.text: S4 min 28: back leg gps 3.63 vs out 3.15 => true current ~0.24 but computer est 0.12 => pace over-read 1.06-1.09 (above threshold) while HR 178.6 read 0.95. Set hr_trust_up_to_share 1.1 so agree averages HR+pace (now threshold ~1.0). HR matched model within ~1 bpm at endurance and threshold today even at 23C, so HR is a good damper of current-estimate lag. No wakes left in S4. Next session: re-judge trust/current.

text: HR now averaged with pace up to 1.1 of CP to damp the lagging current estimate; display reads threshold.

arguments.text: S4 lesson: 33-38 at 69 spm pace 1.09 vs HR 0.93; averaging (trust 1.1) showed threshold, likely wrong if above-threshold planned. HR cannot separate threshold from above threshold for this paddler (reads ~0.93-1.0 for both): never trust HR above ~0.75. S5: 32C HOT, not much current. Warm-up HR +7.5 over model at raw pace 0.58 => heat. Set pre-turn current 0, HR trust 0.61, hr_offset 7, extra creep 1/10min; hard stretches read by pace.

arguments.why: check first hard stretch and current once known; ask feel in heat

text: Heat offset applied to heart rate, pre-turn current set to zero; hard efforts read by pace.

arguments.text: S5 min 11: stretch 8-20 at 67 spm, pace 0.95-0.99 threshold; HR 179 (near max, heat) so HR useless here. Current small (est -0.07 back leg). Paddler: Feeling the heat today. Guide kept.

text: Pace carries the threshold reading; guide kept.

arguments.text: S5 min 26: 3-min easy 20-23 at 50 spm pace 0.52-0.54, HR 169-170 (+11-12 vs model incl. lag residue => heat excess ~9 at min 21, i.e. ~+1/10min extra creep, matches guide). Second hard stretch 23-35 at 67 spm pace 0.99-1.0 threshold, current ~0. Guide kept.

arguments.why: check cool-down reading with heat-adjusted heart rate

text: Threshold by pace; guide kept.

arguments.text: S5 min 27 anomaly: after turn 25.7 back-leg pace fell to 0.89 (tempo) at same 67 spm, HR pinned 179.6. Leg speeds: stretch1 out 3.41/back 3.30 (current ~0.055 with boat out), stretch2 out 3.35/back 3.18 => current ~0.085 (est only 0.04, lagging) and water speed down ~3% (heat fatigue, blade efficiency loss). Same 12-min 67-spm plan as stretch1 (threshold ~1.0) => set cp_scale 0.95. RESET cp_scale for the 50-spm cool-down at the 37.9 wake.

text: cp_scale 0.95 for the rest of this hard stretch: the back-leg drop came with the turn (lagging current estimate) plus heat fatigue.

arguments.text: S5 end: stretch 2 back leg read threshold 0.94-0.97 with cp 0.95; out leg after 33.6 ~0.95. Cool-down 50 spm: pace raw 0.48, HR (offset 7 + creep 1/10) 0.505, both recovery; cp_scale reset to 1.0. Heat at 32C added ~+12 bpm at easy effort by min 36 (lag-free).

text: Cool-down reads recovery on both routes; cp_scale back to 1.0.
This alarm compares against the first minute of the cool-down, when heart rate was still falling from the hard effort; both routes now read recovery. Guide kept.
